programs.meaning: Genes downregulated by ETS2 gRNA1 editing; source-defined ETS2-dependent program

programs.derivation: Subtract after exact atlas feature mapping; mapping coverage gate uses the parent source set. Report source and mapped overlap explicitly.

evidence_tiers.A: Independent direct ETS2 loss/gain in primary human myeloid cells; original biological donors and appropriate controls auditable.
evidence_tiers.B: MEK pharmacology in primary human myeloid cells; no assertion of ETS2 mediation.
evidence_tiers.C: Human primary or iPSC macrophage stimulation; context calibration only.
evidence_tiers.D: Cell line, mouse, mixed tissue or observational context; not primary human perturbation validation.
evidence_tiers.R: Original/reused/derivation or selection data; reproduction or calibration with reuse disclosed.

selection_order: Direct A before pharmacological B; C/D/R cannot replace A as direct validation.
Public gene-by-sample raw integer counts, explicit biological donor map, appropriate controls and at least3 complete pairs required.
Within eligible tier, more complete biological donor pairs, then documented freedom from batch/assay confounding, then newer publication, then lexical accession.
discovery_scope: Bounded primary-source search for independent ETS2/MEK myeloid perturbations plus a separate small set of context-calibration datasets. No raw-read processing or access application in this preparation phase.
contrasts: All eligible doses/times versus appropriate matched controls in the selected study must be enumerated and locked before scoring. Related doses/times do not constitute independent replication.
measurement: Raw bulk counts -> log2(CPM+1) over full raw feature universe; exact technical sequencing splits combined, biological cultures averaged after transformation within donor/condition. Other quantities need a separate pre-effect calibration protocol.

matching.reference: Equal condition average within complete donor, then equal donor average, separately by dataset/assay/population.
matching.ordering: Ascending reference abundance, stable feature ID breaks ties; numpy.array_split equal-count bins; candidates retain this order.
matching.seed_rule: int(sha256(f"20260912:{dataset_key}:{stratum_key}:{program_id}".encode()).hexdigest()[:16],16); numpy default_rng PCG64. Exact dataset/stratum strings frozen with sample map.
matching.pool_exclusion: Union of eight original mapped programs plus ETS2.
matching.sampling: 1000 draws, bins ascending per draw, without replacement within set; same draws across donors and related contrasts.
matching.failure: No bin widening; unavailable matched score with raw mean retained.

summary_outputs: all planned contrasts and unavailable statuses
per-program raw and matched means and matching errors
donor-median treated-minus-control difference, full range, positive/negative/zero counts
leave-one-donor-out medians when at least3 remain

expected_primary_direction.MEK_inhibition: negative is mechanism-compatible but does not prove ETS2 specificity
expected_primary_direction.generic_stimulation: No universal ETS2-specific direction assumed; calibration only.

inference_limits: No binary clinical efficacy or universal activity-score validation from directional agreement.
Healthy donor experimental transfer does not establish PSC clinical response.
